gloss: right in half; split in two

definitions.gloss: right in half; split exactly in two; clean in two
definitions.explanation: Describes something being divided or split into exactly two equal parts, often with force or decisiveness.
Describes a group or situation where opinions, positions, or results are split evenly into two opposing sides.

examples.japanese: スイカ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧。
examples.english: To split a watermelon right in half.
The board snapped clean in two.

examples.english: The large tree was split right in half by a lightning strike.

examples.english: Opinions were split right down the middle.

examples.english: The vote results were evenly split.

examples.english: Public opinion is sharply divided between for and against.

notes:
Composed of {真|ま} (true/right/exact) + ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧ (two), with the っ gemination for emphasis. The {真|ま} prefix intensifies the meaning, indicating a clean, exact division. Can also be written as {真二|まふた}つ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧: to split right in half
- {真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{折|お}れる→折れる：01266_oreru⟧: to snap in two
- {真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{裂|さ}ける→裂ける：02283_sakeru⟧: to tear in half
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かれる→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧: opinions split evenly

USAGE:
The word conveys a vivid, dramatic image of clean division. In physical contexts, it suggests a forceful or decisive break. In figurative contexts (opinions, votes), it emphasizes a sharp, even divide with no middle ground.

RELATED WORDS:
{真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つ follows the same pattern as other {真|ま} + っ intensifiers: ⟦{真|ま}っ{赤|か}→真っ赤：03734_makka⟧ (bright red), ⟦{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}→真っ白：07613_masshiro⟧ (pure white), ⟦{真|ま}っ{暗|くら}→真っ暗：07616_makkura⟧ (pitch dark).
